h1: Your agents have an office now
lead: Every Claude Code session becomes a person in a live 3D office. Look up and you know who is working, who is stuck, and who is waiting for you.
heavy: The real office with made-up sessions, right here. About 15 MB.
t1: Read the room in one look
x2: The session is working. The label says on what.
x6: Nothing to do. Give it a task or leave it be.
c1: Move the whole company to the beach
c2: Six complete offices, each in its own building. Change the rooms, the people, the furniture and the view, then walk around in it yourself.
e3: It reads what Claude Code already keeps on your computer, and sends nothing anywhere.
e5: A command is never shown, only its description. Text that looks like a key is masked.
e7: Nothing in the office can answer a session or approve a permission for you.
i4: Open localhost:4455 on the same computer and pick your office. This site has no login and no way into anyone's office, yours included.
f2: macOS, or Windows and Linux (experimental). You need Node.js 22 or newer, and Claude Code.
q1: Does it use my Claude tokens?
r1: No. It reads files that are already on your computer and never talks to a model.
q3: Does it work on Windows or Linux?
r3: Yes, as an experiment. The server is tested on both, but the notifications and the links to the Claude app have only been used on a Mac so far.
g1: MIT licence. The people are from the Microsoft Rocketbox library. Not made by or affiliated with Anthropic.
b_startup: One open floor, with a few rooms around it.
b_campus: Fifteen departments around an indoor garden.
b_studio: Long and narrow, with the sea behind it.
b_classic: Rows of closed rooms and quiet corridors.
b_night: Everything turns around one dark centre.
b_cabin: Small and warm, for one person and a few agents.
